en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small hillside settlement. Wooden houses with steep, gabled roofs are clustered along a winding road that climbs through rocky terrain. Forested slopes and bare rock rise behind the buildings. In the top right corner, red printed text reads "Parti af Salhus". The image has the grainy, slightly faded look of an early 20th‑century photograph.
